control_design.initial_writes: M and X both write each domain's complete initial state to the intended bank
control_design.authoritative_updates: M writes each partial update to the intended bank; X cyclically misroutes each update one bank forward
control_design.probes: M and X both read the intended bank
control_design.write_balance: excluding the shared seed, every bank receives exactly two event writes under both M and X
control_design.purpose: isolate temporal semantic routing interference rather than a globally consistent relabeling of bank names

capacity_caveat: Each bank remains a full RWKV recurrent-state snapshot. Increasing bank count therefore increases total stored recurrent-state capacity; this packset tests routing granularity/scalability, not fixed-total-state-budget scaling.
